messages:
Alyssa: looping in Pegasus contacts — we got green light for a co-sell pilot. Need to align on pilot scope + tech blockers
Jordan: awesome. Pegasus asked for a 3-week pilot with 5 internal apps, SSO (SAML), and telemetry to their SIEM. Also want a committed throughput target (peak 200 rps)
Miguel: on capacity — we can propose a small Dedicated pool (2xA10G equiv). Need to confirm latency SLO (p50/p95) and KV cache sizing. Will that work for them?
Ben (Pegasus): latency p95 target is <300ms for short chat flows. We can relax to 500ms for embeddings/rerank. Committed throughput is most important. Also want per-route token billing so we can forecast costs.
Sana: on SSO — we support SAML 2.0, can take IdP metadata URL or raw XML. Ben, can Pegasus provide metadata? Any required attributes?
Ben (Pegasus): yes, we'll provide metadata. They need nameid (email) and a custom claim 'peg:org_id'. Can you add attribute mapping?
Miguel: we can map attributes on the private control plane. If this is Hosted API, we recommend a Private deployment or Dedicated with VPC peering for their telemetry needs.
Alyssa: action items: (1) provide SAML SP metadata sample to Pegasus, (2) draft committed capacity quote + uplift for standby burst, (3) run a network egress checklist for their security team. Who takes which?
Jordan: I'll draft the commercial — committed capacity price + 15% burst buffer. Will include token-level example pricing and a simple calculator.
Sana: I'll send the SAML SP metadata example and attribute mapping doc. Also adding an example assertion snippet:
```
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name="email"/>
  <saml:Attribute Name="peg:org_id"/>
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```
Miguel: I'll scope infra: expected GPU type, estimated KV cache (10GB), and a basic runbook for failover to hosted fallback model if Dedicated is degraded. Will include canary rollout plan.
Ben (Pegasus): security questionnaire flag: they want egress controls, data residency (EU region), and KMS integration for keys. We have a doc we can share — want Redwood to confirm compat.
Sana: KMS + HSM support is available in our Private offering; Hosted supports customer-managed keys via KMS in most regions. We'll confirm EU region availability for the pilot.
Alyssa: blocker: legal asked about data retention and logs — can we offer 90-day retention for pilot logs and redaction for PII?
Miguel: yes, can set retention window to 90 days and we have built-in PII redaction hooks. I'll add exact config params.
Jordan: timeline proposal: Week 0 — SSO & network prep; Week 1 — infra provisioning + smoke tests; Week 2 — pilot traffic ramp; Week 3 — evaluation + handoff. Ben, is that acceptable?
Ben (Pegasus): yes, that's tight but doable. Need pricing by EOD Friday. Also want an enablement session for their engineers during Week 1.
Alyssa: OK — we'll schedule a 60-min enablement + runbook walk-through. Miguel, can you run the demo script?
Miguel: will prepare a minimal demo: auth flow, sample prompt patterns, and telemetry dashboard walkthrough.
infra-bot: deploy-request received: dedicated-pool/pegasus-pilot.queued
Sana: attaching links: SAML sample (internal), SSO mapping guide, and the pilot checklist. (links in thread)
Alyssa: perfect. Jordan — ping me when quote draft is ready and I'll loop AM/legal. Ben — thanks, we'll aim to deliver SAML example + quote by Friday. :thumbsup:
Ben (Pegasus): thanks team, appreciate the quick turn.
Jordan: noted. I'll post the draft here when ready.
